description: Where the owner is, as named places only (no coordinates), from iPhone Shortcuts arrive/leave events. Producer: phone (`phone where --json`). Readers: Steward place sense. Every key is present; null means unknown. Times are ISO 8601 UTC strings. state: at = arrived at `place` and not left since; out = left `place` (last_event) and not arrived anywhere since; unknown = no event in the last 24 h, or none ever. A missing event is never read as home. Additive changes keep v1; any other change is v2.

home.description: Mac overnight city, independent of current named-place state. Unique city/country winner by night sample count in the trailing 30 days (00:00 inclusive to 06:00 exclusive Europe/Athens); at least seven uniquely supporting nights and a strict majority of placed nights. Each night supports its unique sample winner; tied placed nights remain in the denominator. Unknown samples cast no vote. since is the earliest winning-city sample in the window, not continuous residence. nights counts supporting nights, or null when unreadable; unknown city/country/since are null, ok reason is null. IP geolocation is approximate, not GPS. Missing, unreadable or insufficient evidence is unknown.
